text.description_html:
Bommer BB5001-454-605 4 1/2" x 4" Solid Brass Hinge.

Square Corners, 2 Ball Bearings. 0.134" thick (gauge).

Package includes one (1) door hinge, matching solid brass flathead, Phillips screws and standard removable button tip pin and plug.

Fitted with a high grade, removable, rust resistant, stainless steel pin.

Utilizes template screw hole pattern for use with wood or metal doors.

Polished Brass finish.
